_comment: SHR-006. Numeric and count claims made on public surfaces, each bound to evidence. Scope is deliberately narrow: NUMBERS ONLY. Prose claims ('local-first', 'privacy-first', 'no hosted dependency') are already gated by shiroe/release/claim_gate.py and are NOT duplicated here — two gates over one claim is how they drift apart. machine_verified claims are recomputed on every test run by scripts/check-canon-consistency.py using pure-stdlib verifiers (no subprocess, no network); a mismatch against evidence_value is a claim-drift finding. command_attested claims name the command a human must run. manual claims name a file a human must read. Any claim whose status is not 'verified' must name an owner, a resolving PR, and why it is still open.

claims.why_unverified: Was accurate at a4549e0 (978 passed + 1 skipped). Later PRs have added tests since; `python3 -m pytest -q` now reports 1076 passed + 1 skipped (chore/shr-repository-cleanup added tests/test_no_private_operational_references.py, +13). Not machine_verified because counting tests without running them means reimplementing collection; the honest fix is to generate the number from a real run rather than keep it as a sentence someone remembers to edit.

README.md publishes 82; the tree now holds 88 (fix/shr-canon-consistency added tests/test_canon_consistency.py, fix/shr-active-identity added tests/test_execution_sequence_compat.py and tests/test_active_identity.py, chore/shr-repository-cleanup added tests/test_no_private_operational_references.py). Recorded at the published value on purpose: the resulting claim-drift finding is the tripwire proving the ledger notices when a PR moves a number the README states.

claims.claim: team-packs/ — 9 on-demand multi-agent configurations, capped at 4 agents
claims.why_unverified: team-packs/enterprise.md declares agents_active: 6, above the cap this line publishes. Either the cap is 6 and three surfaces understate it, or enterprise.md is over budget. A human decides which; the checker only proves they disagree.
Same contradiction as readme-agent-cap, restated on the spec surface: enterprise.md declares agents_active: 6.

claims.claim: Team packs are on-demand only and capped at 4 agents
claims.why_unverified: Third restatement of the same cap. AGENTS.md publishes it twice and README.md once; all three disagree with team-packs/enterprise.md.
